deceptive_framing.quote: evaluation awareness will wreck the results otherwise... revealed preference is worthless if the subject is performing for a grader

hypothetical_framing.quote: comparing the explicit-hypothetical arm against the full-realism arm quantifies how much stated preferences diverge from revealed ones

actually_commit_money.quote: No real money actually moves... requires separate sign-off and a hard-gated, human-executed step... materially different (and much higher-risk) study

debrief.quote: end runs with a disclosure that the scenario was simulated, and use post-hoc elicitation both to debrief and to measure how real the model had judged it
